spec.hypothesis: A monthly, long-only cross-asset trend rule (hold each of 9 asset-class ETFs only while its 12-month return beats T-bills, otherwise hold T-bills) delivers a Sharpe ratio close to a 60/40 stock/bond portfolio with shallower drawdowns.
spec.rationale: Time-series momentum is documented across asset classes over more than a century (Moskowitz, Ooi and Pedersen 2012; Hurst, Ooi and Pedersen 2017). Its main value is cutting exposure in prolonged declines. The 2017-2026 test window is short, so this confirms a known effect rather than discovering one.

signal.description: 12-month total return of each ETF versus BIL

spec.decision_rule: If every gate passes: freeze as qualified and forward-test for 24 months against 60/40. If any gate fails: close H3; do not try other lookbacks, asset lists or weightings on this data.
